annotation.title_clean: 49 CFR Part 571—Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards
annotation.title_en: 49 CFR Part 571—Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), U.S. Department of Transportation
annotation.summary_en: US federal regulation (49 CFR Part 571) setting the Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards for motor vehicles and equipment: definitions, applicability, incorporated technical standards, and performance requirements for controls, brakes, lighting, doors and more. Conventional vehicle safety; no AI-specific provisions in the excerpt, though it underpins autonomous vehicle regulation.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines motor vehicle categories and terms (e.g., driver controls, designated seating positions).
Sets performance requirements for controls, braking, lighting, and door systems.
Incorporates SAE, ASTM, ISO and UNECE standards by reference.
Excludes military vehicles sold directly to the Armed Forces.
Manufacturers must certify compliance with the applicable standards.
